0.reason: A one-token remainder is admitted deliberately so a manifest's bare ids still parse; the measured defect, multi-token log records, is closed.

findings.text: non-blocking: _FAILURE_BARE_ID_RE matches any single non-space token, so the predicate admits any line beginning FAILED/ERROR whose remainder is one token (for example 'ERROR OSError' printed by a test or a plugin) as a failing id; it is the residual of the same printed-record defect class, accepted deliberately so a manifest's bare test name still compares, and a reader wanting the plan's rule exactly could require the bare token to look like a test name.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified the production readers that reach the changed function: promotion_checks.py:1968, promotion_evidence.py:1141, :1215, :1260 and :1464, standing_suite.py:427, and review.py's own added_failures_from_gate_logs:2895 and annotate_added_failures:2931.
item_verdicts.diff: read the three commits against base 6d1ea919b: 6829476db narrows _pytest_failure_ids to node-id-shaped ids; 821d64158 corrects the predicate so a bare test name stays an identity, which the shared matching rule at reckon/crew/review.py:2061 requires; 365cb32771 adds the evidence fragment; the new 128-line test file ships with the fix.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when asks for a test fed two arms with the same failing ids where the head also prints captured records asserting zero added failures, a second case with one real added id, a negative control restoring the base parser, importer-population arms at all_debug with -n 4 adding no failure, and clean ruff on the staged paths; the manifest records each, and I verified the armed pair (armed-base.log 51 passed, armed-after.log 54 passed, both EXIT=0), the negative control (negative-control.log 3 failed EXIT=1), the population delta (224 ids each, 0 added, 0 removed) and both ruff checks.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that a printed warning is not counted as a failing test; reckon/crew/review.py:1807 and :1820-1825 define and apply the captured-record exclusion, so a line such as 'ERROR package.module:file.py:3553 message' is no longer read as a failing id.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 6829476db, 821d64158 and 365cb3277, changed_paths naming review.py, the new test and the fragment, tests and test_logs naming the armed pair, the population arms and the negative control, baseline_suite (6d1ea919b, 0 failures) and after_suite (821d6415, 0 failures).
item_verdicts.write_paths: the fence was reckon/crew/review.py, reckon/crew/promotion_records.py, tests/test_a_printed_warning_is_not_a_failure.py, the evidence fragment and a figures directory; the diff touches only review.py, the new test and the fragment, all inside the fence.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_printed_warning_is_not_a_failure.py:100 fails if the base parse is restored, which the recorded negative control demonstrates ((2, [two printed records]) against the asserted (0, [])), and :114-115 catches the opposite regression by requiring exactly the one genuinely added id.
justifications.evidence: armed-base.log (rev 6d1ea919b) reads 51 passed EXIT=0 and armed-after.log (rev 821d6415) reads 54 passed EXIT=0 with zero failures at each arm; negative-control.log reads 3 failed EXIT=1 with the first case reporting (2, [the two printed records]); I re-derived the population logs with the landed code (224 ids at each arm, 0 added, 0 removed) and re-ran ruff check and ruff format --check on the landed files (clean).
justifications.fit: the added helpers at reckon/crew/review.py:1805-1825 are module-private, describe the mechanism in their comments with no plan, sprint or ticket identifier and no attribution, and sit beside the _GATE_FAILURE_RE they constrain, matching the surrounding style at reckon/crew/review.py:1796.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review.py:1820-1825 rejects the captured-record shape and reckon/crew/review.py:2240 skips such a line, so a printed record is never read as a failing id while a node id, a collection-error .py path and a bare test name still are, exactly the plan's deliverable.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the one reader at reckon/crew/review.py:2216 that reckon/crew/standing_suite.py:427 and the promotion readers already call, rather than adding a second reader; the repository still owns a separate broad parse at reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:210, left untouched because it is outside the fence and recorded under outside_scope.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 6d1ea919b..365cb32771 lists exactly reckon/crew/review.py, tests/test_a_printed_warning_is_not_a_failure.py and the evidence fragment, all inside the declared fence; promotion_records.py and the figures directory are declared but untouched, which is a subset rather than an excess.
